## Summary

Describe the focused change and the roadmap phase it completes.

## Validation

- [ ] `pytest`
- [ ] `ruff check .`
- [ ] `ruff format --check .`
- [ ] Relevant Docker/integration tests
- [ ] Frontend checks, if applicable

## Safety and evidence

- [ ] No secrets, private data, model weights, or generated runs are included.
- [ ] Target execution remains Docker-only.
- [ ] Objective verification is not replaced by LLM output.
- [ ] Limitations and skips are documented.
